items.label: 【Trustworthy Kitchen Rugs】
items.value: The kitchen floor mats are made of tight and absorbent fiber fabric and non-slip rubber backing. So don't worry about the splashed water and oil while cooking. And the rubber backing can prevent water from soaking through to the floor. Besides, They also can provide extra cushioning underfoot while you're cooking or working.

items.label: 【Non-Skid & Waterproof Rubber Backing】
items.value: With its non-slip & waterproof rubber backing design, the kitchen mats for floor can grip the ground firmly to keep you and your family safe and protect your kitchen floor dry and clean from moisture and stain. Suitable for tile, marble, hardwood floors and other smooth surfaces.

items.label: 【Easy to Clean and Maintain】
items.value: The kitchen rugs are easy to clean, you can just use vacuum to maintain them on daily. And the kitchen floor mats are high-quality and durable, also can be washed in the washing machine or rinsed with the hose. No need to worry about fading.

items.label: 【Classic Appearance】
items.value: The classic colors are suitable for various kitchen styles and can effectively decorate your kitchen. What's more, the weaving structure design is a good way to keep the kitchen clean and provide fashion, comfort and warmth for the cold tile or hardwood floors.

items.label: 【Wildly Used and Great Gift Choice】
items.value: The farmhouse kitchen rugs sets of 2pcs can perfectly decorate or complement a foyer or entryway, back door, living room, dining room, kitchen floor, in front of sink, hallways, high-traffic areas. And it is a great room decor gift option for winter, Christmas, Thanksgiving and New Year.

items.label: 【Note】
items.value: You will receive 2 pcs kitchen floor mats (17.3 x 47 inches and 17.3 x 29inches). The kitchen carpets are packaged in rolls, so don't worry about the creases. If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us, we will reply to you and solve them in the first time.
